title: Shift Time Input
summary: Reads shift times the way they're meant, so 22:00–06:00 is 8 h overnight and 9–5 isn't logged as 20 h.
description: Shift time input that treats 22:00–06:00 as an 8 h overnight shift, asks whether 9:00–5:00 meant 5 PM, questions 0 h, over-long and 26:00-style entries, deducts breaks (catching one typed in hours) and counts real hours across a DST change.
catches: Overnight shifts ending the next day
A break typed in hours instead of minutes
Real hours when clocks change mid-shift, given date and time zone
limits: Break rules and maximums are what you configure; labour law is not built in
DST correction needs date and timeZone props
a11y: Start, end and break inputs have <label>s; aria-invalid on unparseable times
Readback and status linked via aria-describedby and a polite live region
Errors use role=alert; warnings are text with icons
Length has an aria-label in words
